newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya rejects 23,000 tonnes US maize over quality.
newsitem.headline: Kenya rejects 23,000 tonnes US maize over quality.

text.p: Kenya has rejected 23,000 tonnes of maize imported from the U.S. because it is broken and discloured, officials said on Wednesday.
National Cereals and Produce Board (NCPB) spokesman Justus Kemei said tests had been carried out at Mombasa port by Societe Generale de Surveillance.
"Usually we sent our officers to exporting countries to carry out pre-shipment tests, but this time we did not send anyone to the U.S.," Kemei said.
It was not possible to establish which company imported the maize -- which port officials said arrived on March 17.
International Commodities and Cargill SA have each been contracted by the NCPB to import a part of seven million bags of maize the government needs to alleviate famine.
